name: Zone I · Scene 1: Hephaestus’s Forge & The Five-Fold Shield
greek: Πρῶταคลὲν σάκος ποίει μέγα τε στιβαρόν τε πάντοσε δαιδάλλων, περὶ δ᾽ ἄντυγα βάλλε φαεινὴν τρίπλακα μαρμαρέην, ἐκ δ᾽ ἀργύρεον τελαμῶνα.
buckley: First of all he formed a shield, both large and solid, adorning it all over; and around it he threw a shining border, triple, glittering; and from it suspended a silver belt. Five were the folds of the shield itself; but on it he formed many ornaments with cunning skill.

worldModel.vision: Crucible glow of bronze (28), tin (71), gold (297), and silver (179) ingots against basalt forge walls (72); twenty golden-wheeled tripods.
worldModel.memory: Twenty bellows blow into the crucibles by degree as Hephaestus’s work requires; five metallic folds laminate into a single world-surface.
worldModel.controller: Hephaestus hammers the five folds on the great anvil while silver-footed Thetis receives the operative world-shield.

shots.name: The Roaring Bellows
shots.beat: Hephaestus turns his twenty bellows to the fire and casts bronze, tin, priceless gold, and silver into the flame.

shots.name: Silver-Footed Thetis Waits
shots.beat: Thetis watches as the great anvil takes the five-fold laminate of the shield.

shots.name: The Triple Glittering Rim
shots.beat: Around it he throws a shining triple border and suspends from it a silver baldric.
